message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: illegal mining of rare earth minerals without permit, causing resource damage. The typical Chinese criminal law offense: illegal mining (非法采矿) which falls under "非法采矿罪" (illegal mining) under Article 338? Actually Article 338 of Criminal Law: "非法采矿罪" (illegal mining) – for mining without permit causing damage to resources. Also possibly "破坏资源罪"? The examples: For illegal mining, earlier example: "滥伐林木" for illegal logging. For illegal mining, we need to see similar pattern. In Chinese law, there is "非法采矿罪" (illegal mining). Also could be "破坏矿产资源罪". The crime is "非法采矿罪". The answer format: [罪名]非法采矿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法占用农用地"? No, they are mining, not land. So just illegal mining.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法采矿<eoa>
